Management need to review their smoking policy
Feb 2019 • Couples
I found this bar on TripAdvisor and being a gin lover I had to visit. It was a cosy bar with dark furnishings and great background music. It was happy hour which meant the cocktails were even more excellent value for money. There was a vast array of gin to choose from. The bartenders expertly created the cocktails, which were attractively presented. 

I have given an average rating because there was no food/snacks available to purchase, but the main reason is because smoking was allowed. My husband and I were choosing another drink when new customers arrived and started smoking next to us. There is so much research showing the dangers of passive smoking that I cannot believe it still happens. 

We chose to pay the bill and leave at that point - a shame because until then we had enjoyed ourselves.

Fantastic evening....then spoiled!
Feb 2019 • Couples
What a great pity this was. We had a fantastic couple of hours sampling various Gin Cocktails, the advantage of sitting at the bar is you can interact with the staff and watch them compile your wonderfully presented drinks. The place itself is very small and intimate with a great atmosphere, like a secret drinking den really.

 Then it happened....two gentlemen entered and asked to be seated upstairs so they could smoke, after a discussion they decided to stand outside the front of the premises to smoke which was very considerate of them. It was then that a member of staff approached them and invited them to come inside, sit at the bar and smoke there. 

Within a few minutes the smell in the room changed and the smoke was everywhere, it was unbelievable that was encouraged in such a confined space with no respect for fellow customers. At this point we had no other option but to drink up and leave, we were both very disappointed and annoyed because we had intended to stay and purchase further drinks. 

If you want to lose customers then continue to abuse their health, it’s not acceptable in the modern world and really let this otherwise excellent bar down. Common sense should tell the owners that the place is so small that smoking shouldn’t be allowed, they didn’t care though.

Amazing, creative cocktails - go for happy hour!
Oct 2018 • Couples
My husband and I honeymooned in Vietnam in October 2018 and I saw a listing for this place on Google Maps. It was close to our hotel and we love gin, so we're like, let's go! First off, it's REALLY hard to find. If you're using Google Maps to get you there, it'll take you to the wrong place. The Gin House is in an ALLEY behind the main road. Don't give up! Ask for directions when you get close, if need be.

The Gin House has a speak-easy vibe. Dark inside, wood bar, red velvet. Their happy hour is from 5 pm until 8 pm and it's totally worth it! A number of the cocktails -- which are already inexpensive by American standards -- are half price! We had an amazing time trying out a variety of truly unique and creative cocktails. Some came with herbs or ginger you were supposed to "nibble" on while you sipped the cocktail, the enhance the experience. One of the drinks came on a bed of smoking dry ice! We chatted with the mixologist bartender some, who was very nice and spoke English.

We didn't have any of the bar snacks, but they do offer limited food options. It was never crowded when we were there, but supposedly gets crowded later in the evening. Hit this place up if you like fancy cocktails!
